spec.name: Souk Sebta
spec.description: Souk Sebta (also known as Kissariat Souk Sebta) is a major commercial center in the heart of Ksar el-Kebir. Historically known as the 'Grain Market,' it has evolved into a bustling modern marketplace specializing in textiles, electronics, and cosmetics. It is considered the city's second most important market after the Central Market, serving as a primary shopping destination for both locals and visitors from surrounding provinces.

timeline.title: Grain Market
timeline.description: Operation as the city's primary market for grain and cereals.

timeline.title: Modern Kissaria
timeline.description: Conversion into a permanent 'Kissaria' (covered market) with hundreds of specialized shops.

comments: The market includes its own mosque for the convenience of traders and shoppers.
